card.name: Small words inside religious titles
card.fires_on: Small linking or punctuation tokens (THE, OF, opening quotes, parentheses, a space) that come right after a religious or cultural name or term in general web text, where a title or gloss continues, as in ANTONY THE GREAT or MAN OF SIN.

modes.label: Capitalized title joiners
modes.description: THE or OF in an all-caps saint or biblical title, before the rest of the title.
modes.example: He must have spent some time with Saint ANTONY<< THE>> GREAT before his death.

modes.label: Opening quote or bracket for a gloss
modes.description: An opening quote mark or parenthesis after a foreign religious term, introducing its translation or variant.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on small joining or punctuation marks inside religious names and titles, just before the next part of the title or a translation.
